name: Plea To The Alliance
summary: At the shattered Thandol Span, Plea To The Alliance carries a desperate call for aid from Dun Modr's dwarven survivors. Dark Iron infiltrators slaughtered the garrison, and the dwarves appeal to the human forces at Refuge Pointe, though the Alliance is stretched thin.

sections.title: A Cry Across the Chasm
sections.body: Dun Modr lies devastated, and Dark Iron dwarves have sabotaged the Thandol Span. The survivors hold a precarious foothold at the Wetlands' northern rim. Ironforge's main reserves have yet to arrive, so Rhag Garmason and Longbraid the Grim look north to the Arathi Highlands. They learn that Alliance forces have made camp at Refuge Pointe. Garmason sends an emissary across the shattered bridge to ask Captain Nials for urgent military aid.

sections.title: The Plight of Stromgarde
sections.body: At Refuge Pointe, Captain Nials offers sympathy to Longbraid's soldiers, but cannot spare a single fighter. Stromgarde has fallen into ruin, overrun by Syndicate rogues, Boulderfist ogres, and Witherbark trolls. Its surviving defenders are committed to reclaiming their ancestral capital. Bound by honor and pressed by their own desperate struggle, Nials sends word that the dwarves at the Span must stand alone.

faq.q: Who sends the plea to Refuge Pointe?
aliases: who gives plea to the alliance
faq.answer: Rhag Garmason, near the ruined bridgehead of the Thandol Span on the Wetlands border, sends the plea for Longbraid the Grim and Dun Modr's remaining defenders.

faq.q: Why do the dwarves need help from Refuge Pointe?
faq.answer: Dark Iron clan infiltrators attacked Dun Modr and sabotaged the Thandol Span. While the survivors await Ironforge's heavy reserves, they lack the numbers to retake their settlement and secure the crossing alone.

faq.q: Why does Captain Nials refuse to send soldiers?
faq.answer: Captain Nials cannot spare troops because Stromgarde has collapsed into ruins. The human forces at Refuge Pointe are committed to reclaiming Stromgarde from the Syndicate, ogres, and forest trolls.
Refuge Pointe lies just off the main road in the central Arathi Highlands, north of the Thandol Span crossing between the Wetlands and Arathi.
The Dark Iron clan overwhelmed and sacked Dun Modr after infiltrating through the mountains to sever the land route between the southern dwarven lands and the northern Alliance territories.

faq.q: What happens after Captain Nials turns down the request?
aliases: what next plea to the alliance
faq.answer: Captain Nials sends his regrets to Longbraid the Grim and confirms that no human reinforcements are coming. The dwarven survivors at the bridge must rely on their own wits, wandering adventurers, and distant Ironforge reinforcements.

angles.text: For dwarves, Dun Modr's isolation is painful: even longtime human allies are too besieged to lend a hand.
As a human traveler, you witness Captain Nials' sorrow as he weighs Alliance brotherhood against Stromgarde's survival.
For the Alliance, this exchange shows how fractured its northern Eastern Kingdoms remain, with local garrisons fighting separate, desperate battles without shared reserves.
